scope: Read-only descriptive temporal generalization audit; no fitting, no model changes, no test labels.

sources.water_value_quote: Marginal water value for each reservoir at the start of the day. Unit: EUR/MWh.
sources.terminal_time: The supplied example sets final water value to start + 168 hours.
sources.price_dependency: No generation recipe or claim that synthetic water values depend on prices is supplied in the definitions or task description. Observed correlation is descriptive, not proof of construction.
sources.normalization_caveat: Simple feeding-reservoir price-minus-water-value and normalized versions are statistical features, not a derivation of SHOP marginal economics.

method.reference: Labelled training cases starting 2015-01-01 through 2021-12-25 inclusive (last horizon ends at 2022 boundary); excludes six overlapping late-2021 cases.
method.per_year: Cases grouped by start year, including all labelled cases in 2021 and 2022 and mapped prediction cases in 2023/2024. Descriptive input comparisons may inspect provided prediction inputs; labels stop at 2022.
method.week_scale: max(mean(abs(all 168 supplied hourly prices)),10 EUR/MWh). Uses inputs from same supplied forecast case only.
method.zscore: (price - mean(168 supplied hourly prices))/max(std(168 supplied hourly prices),1 EUR/MWh).
method.ks: Two-sample KS distance used as descriptive distribution difference; no p-values or independence claims (cases overlap).
method.on_rate: Fraction of ON labels across that year/cases and 168 hours per generator.
method.auc: Unfitted per-generator descriptive AUC of a fixed input score. No model/threshold/feature learned from labels.

findings: 2022 is a severe financial regime shift: case-hour mean price 211.2408 vs 34.2458 EUR/MWh in purged 2015-2021 training; 74.67% of 2022 prices lie outside training p01-p99.

Weekly price z-scores have much smaller descriptive shift than raw prices: KS distances vs training are 0.0189 (2022), 0.0371 (2023), 0.0372 (2024), versus raw 0.8753, 0.6956, 0.4234. Zero centering alone leaves 2022 KS 0.3661.

Label prevalence also changes materially: Songa ON 53.92% in pooled training vs 11.71% in 2022; Haukeli 60.61% vs 14.15%; Tokke_G1 70.09% vs 45.67%. Large gaps are not solely generic model overfitting.

Normalization is not uniformly better as a standalone score: 2022 Lio raw margin AUC 0.8301 vs scaled 0.8897 and Songa 0.9676 vs 0.9822, but Haukeli 0.7304 vs 0.7171. Distribution stability alone does not prove predictive invariance.
Prediction years introduce substantially negative prices absent from previous labels: annual minimum -61.84 in 2023 and -59.96 in 2024, compared with -1.97 in 2015-2022.

Songa/Bitdalsvatn supplied water values undergo another regime change: annual median 292.53 EUR/MWh in 2022, 111.83 in 2023, 0.01 in 2024. Water-value inputs are exactly equal within five fixed reservoir groups across the full file.
Provided documentation states units and terminal date, not how synthetic water values were generated. A price-dependent generation formula cannot be established from these files.
recommended_next_experiment: Supplement the current inputs with within-case price z-scores, scale-normalized terminal water values and margins (and normalized price differences across windows); retain original inputs and case scale. Freeze architecture/seed count, evaluate purged chronological 2020/2021/2022 holdouts, and report per-generator results. Fixed absolute start/stop costs and hydraulic constraints mean common price rescaling is not guaranteed to leave the optimized schedule invariant.
